title: Slices of dyn Trait vs impl Trait
prompt: Why is &[dyn Trait] valid as a parameter type while &[`impl Trait`] is rejected by the compiler?
answer: `&[dyn Trait]` is a slice of trait object fat pointers, where every reference has a known uniform size. `impl Trait` is not allowed inside slice type position because `impl Trait` is only permitted for top-level function arguments or return types.
